Source: https://docs.elgato.com/streamdeck/sdk/guides/keys/
Retrieved: 2026-11-09
Publisher: Elgato, Stream Deck SDK 3.0.0 guide
Scope: Short attributed excerpts only; not a complete upstream document or executable trace.

Multi-State Keys:
“When supporting two states, the state is toggled when the user presses the key, with the new state index available via the payload information.”

Animated image formats:
“The setImage function does not support animated image formats, such as GIF.”

Interpretation for this implementation: a successful single-key press has the new two-state index in its event payload; key release does not initiate a second transition. This is documentary evidence, not reference-host or physical-device qualification. GIF manifest image discovery is separately supported by manifest-schema/latest.ts. Preserving a GIF byte stream is not evidence of native animated playback.
